svg.title: Air traffic controller — Non-binary person
svg.desc: A fictional non-binary person working as air traffic controller, wearing a collared shirt and a communications headset. Visible work cue: A circular radar display has two full radii defining an open sweep sector and one separate target blip. The person is on the right, with the work cue on the left. Occupational headgear: a communications headset.
